analysis:
Examined both supplied ProviderLoop.swift excerpts and the complete changed-range map/patch. Changes add selected-model recovery state and a test load override (head 781–785), saved selection/switch tracking (786–792), and initialization from backend.enabledModels (954). These declarations and initialization do not themselves change inference admission, expose prompt/key material, grant authorization, alter encryption/cache scoping, or affect billing; no concrete regression is supported here. The head 198–532 surrounding state retains connection generations, drain/loading barriers, failed-self-test tombstones, memory-budget epochs, and add-on holds. The base 1062–1186 ModelSlot retains artifact/cache identities and vision memory sizing; this excerpt is unchanged by the supplied range map.
Integration must examine ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery and its changed callers: verify recovery honors committed selection, does not re-advertise failed builds, and preserves no-eviction memory admission, shutdown/add-on hold fences, and connection-bound serving authorization (A-018, T-059/T-060, T-053/T-052). Also confirm recovered slots preserve verified artifact and cache bindings (T-027, T-041) rather than treating the saved config filter as serving authority. Implementations and call sites are outside this source scope; their absence is a coverage limit, not evidence of missing controls. Recovery's actual admission/lifecycle behavior remains material to integration review.
